A recording now belongs to a customer, not to a folder — and every place that shows you recordings finally agrees about which customer that is.

## One answer to "whose call is this"

Until now a recording carried two separate marks: the customer it was linked to, and the folder it sat in. The sidebar counted folders. A company's own page listed links. Most ways of filing a recording only set one of the two, so the two halves quietly disagreed.

The clearest version: record a call without picking anyone, then link it to a customer afterwards from the report page. The customer's page listed it — but open that customer in the sidebar and its recordings did not include it. It was still sitting under 未歸戶, and nothing on screen explained why.

The customer now decides where a recording lives, everywhere. Folders became the place the file sits on disk and nothing more: you can no longer create one, because one exists for a customer as soon as that customer has recordings. Everything filed before this keeps its place — a recording sitting in a customer's folder still reads as that customer's, and a folder that never belonged to a customer stays where it is under 其他資料夾（舊資料）.

Recordings with no customer live under 還沒歸戶, which now means exactly what it says.

## Handing a recording to a customer

The recording's customer is one control, reachable from wherever you happen to be looking: the chip in the title bar while a recording is open, the link bar on its report, and a menu on each card in the library. They are the same control, and all of them move the recording for real — the tree, the customer's page and the report can no longer tell you different things.

## Naming a customer who isn't in the list yet

Type a name that doesn't exist and you now get **建立「和運租車」** as the first option, instead of 找不到符合項目 and a dead end. It works for customers and for deal threads, anywhere you pick one.

Importing asks who the recording is for, too — audio files, transcripts, and imports over MCP. Importing while you have a customer open fills them in for you.

## Behind the scenes

- On first launch after this update, recordings that were filed under a customer's folder but never linked get the link written down. It runs once, changes nothing about where anything appears, and needs no attention.
- Fixed: picking something from a search dropdown left the text you had typed behind, so the next thing you typed was appended to it — long enough to invent a customer called 和運租車裕隆汽車.
- Companies, deal threads and people are still stored on this Mac only. On a second Mac, a synced recording's customer cannot be resolved yet, and it appears under 其他資料夾（舊資料）with the customer's name.
